authority: Cryptographic integrity, issuer anchoring, and deterministic capability-state evaluation only. A valid signature does not create legitimacy, office, delegation, or authority.
supersedes_runtime_input_model: prototype boolean facts in apps/web/src/lib/capabilities/evaluator.ts for the primary /vitae/capabilities route; v0.1 remains preserved as a historical prototype

cryptography.prototype_algorithm: ES256 / ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256 using Web Crypto
cryptography.payload_digest: SHA-256 over deterministic canonical JSON subset
cryptography.trust_rule: verification requires an out-of-band trusted issuer anchor matching issuerId, keyId, key fingerprint, required role, capability scope, and system scope
cryptography.critical_limit: the browser demo generates ephemeral keys and in-memory trust anchors; this proves tamper detection and binding only, not durable real-world issuer legitimacy

record_kinds.evidence: signed requirement-specific receipt bound to subject, capability, policy digest, evidence kind, validity window, and source receipt IDs
record_kinds.review: signed review outcome bound to the selected evidence receipt digests and an explicit review authority basis
record_kinds.grant: signed bounded delegation bound to subject, capability, policy digest, selected evidence-set digest, review digest, authority basis, and delegation-chain references
record_kinds.control: signed suspend/resume/revoke lifecycle event targeting one exact grant ID and grant digest
record_kinds.action-registration: destination-signed registration of the executable action and execution-contract digest
record_kinds.destination-decision: destination-signed accept/reject decision bound to one action request, evidence set, review, and grant

destination_execution.law: A Grant Makes an Action Eligible for Execution; the Destination Still Owns Acceptance.

revocation_model.form: signed lifecycle event; original grant is never rewritten

forbidden_authority_inputs: icosahedron, octahedron, junction, cube, or stella alignment
test_vectors: destination-signed action registration and acceptance -> ACTIVE
missing evidence issuer trust anchor -> INELIGIBLE
production_deferred: durable issuer registry and governance of trust-anchor enrollment
delegation-chain legitimacy validation beyond signed string references
persistent receipt storage and local-first synchronization
optional canonical settlement/finality for actions that separately require it
candidate_laws: Evidence Receipt Is a Claim About a Requirement, Not a Score About a Person.
A Grant Must Bind Subject, Verb, Scope, Policy, and Authority Basis.
Revocation Is an Event, Not a Rewrite.
Cryptographic Validity Does Not Equal Legitimacy.
Geometry Remains Outside the Authorization Payload.
